applicability: Reproduce the approved compact editor and its surfaces when requested. It is not a mandatory theme for every product.

authority.layout: Final reference CSS and rendered boxes in Chrome at DPR 1
authority.transition: Reference model code; verify in the consuming project
authority.consumer_validation: Destination integration requires new captures and tests; this profile does not certify it

palette.selection: abs(wrappedHueDifference)<6; do not round the saved hue to a swatch

layout.accessibility: Names, values and status may be sr-only; save failures remain visible.

composition.body: fixed wash + grain separated from text
composition.context: stage is always manual; the page may resolve real context when hold=false; do not invent a contextual entity at the destination

addPool.empty: Clone the last initial pool; select index 0.
addPool.direction: first-second, or (-4,-58) when there is only one pool.
addPool.origin: Existing pool with the lowest y; ties keep the first.
addPool.position: origin + direction; round x/y to one decimal place; do not distribute three points symmetrically.
addPool.hueOffset: First value in [120,-120,62,-62,180] whose absolute difference from each pool.d is >=24; fallback 120.
addPool.insertion: Immediately before the last anchor; select index oldLength-1.

afterPlusFromInitial.swatchExplanation: Hue 301 differs by 7 from swatch 308; the threshold is strictly less than 6.

migration.backup: Back up the original configuration before the first migrated write; a backup or write failure preserves the original.
migration.notAllowed: Recreating defaults to hide appearance differences, or retaining an old renderer without checking whether it prevents the requested fidelity.

gestures.coordinatePaint: left/top=(modelXY+45)/190*100%; no clamp or edge proxy. Points outside the stage are clipped.

plainPointerDrag.selected: center follows the pointer clamped to the stage
plainPointerDrag.others: same delta as the selected pool; preserve vectors and allow offstage positions
plainPointerDrag.snapshot: Calculate deltas against geometry captured on pointerdown; round model x/y to one decimal place.

distanceRing.coincident: If current<.5: x=selected.x; y=clamp(selected.y-requested*(i+1)/others.length,-45,145), rounded to one decimal place.

pointerAccumulator.appliedDistance: max hypot of vectors in model units, without rounding to the displayed label

gestures.plus: Add only the new pool at the specified position/profile; existing coordinates stay unchanged.
gestures.modeAndColor: Do not change x/y or the distance between pools.
gestures.offstagePolicy: Overflow clip prevents internal scrolling; do not invent edge proxies in the faithful profile. A recovery alternative may exist outside the canvas, declared separately.

thirdDragFixture.expectedVisibility: selected pool inside; the other 2 outside and clipped; no visual proxies at the edge.

gestures.invariants: Capture the model and CSS centers of ALL pools before, during and after: verify offsets, selection, clipping and no movement from actions that should not move pools.

stateLifecycle.initialWhen: No configuration/pool list is available; do not use list truthiness to decide.
stateLifecycle.reopen: Preserve valid configurations with 0/1/2/3 pools and offstage positions; do not fill or redistribute them.
stateLifecycle.selectionOnOpen: Last index when pools exist; none when the list is empty.
stateLifecycle.explicitReset: Only on explicit reset: restore initial and select the last pool; preserve hold when resetting lighting.
stateLifecycle.intentionalZero: An empty list, chroma 0, grain 0 and a saved intensity of 5% are valid values; do not replace them with defaults.
stateLifecycle.migration: Convert according to migration, with backup/idempotence; do not use reset as migration.
stateLifecycle.invalidData: Distinguish missing, legacy and invalid data. Validate finiteness/domain; preserve a recoverable original before repairing.
